_doc: make sounds: sounds-src/<variant file> -> app/sound/<key><digit>.mp3. Entries are written by the fal-sfx MCP (generate_sfx) and carry every prompt; lufs overrides default_lufs per entry. last_* keys are bake state. A key that matches any mp3 the pipeline did not write is refused. Targets measured 2026-10-08 with ebur128: ambient-fire.mp3 (the positional loop peer) -26.4 LUFS, ambient-corp1.mp3 bed -42.1, object-elevator -29.6, attack-pistol1 -16.3.
